manifest.name: dsh-publicwww
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: search the source code of hundreds of millions of websites with PublicWWW.

bundle.text:
# DeepSeek Harness patch: the PublicWWW MCP server through the official MCP client.
# The token comes from the PUBLICWWW_TOKEN environment variable (issue one at
# https://publicwww.com/profile/api). Without it the tool list and read_docs still work.
- insert:
    - id: mcp-publicwww
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: publicwww
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://api.publicwww.com/mcp
        headers: !!js "process.env.PUBLICWWW_TOKEN ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.PUBLICWWW_TOKEN}` } : {}"

readme.text:
Search the source code (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) of hundreds of millions of websites
from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): which sites
load a script, use a library, carry a tracking id or a widget.

This plugin connects the PublicWWW MCP server, `https://api.publicwww.com/mcp`,
through DeepSeek Harness's own MCP client. The agent gets PublicWWW's tools:
`search`, `account`, `read_docs` (the documentation and prices) and eight for
clusters, as `mcp__publicwww__<tool>`.

Issue a token on your [profile page](https://publicwww.com/profile/api) - the
tools need a paid plan, a free account gets the documentation only - and keep it
in the environment:

```sh
export PUBLICWWW_TOKEN=...
```

Then add the plugin to a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:publicwww-com/dsh-publicwww
```

or use the patch for a single run:

```sh
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml
```

DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview; if a newer version changes the plugin
format, the server itself stays the same - any MCP client that can send an
`Authorization: Bearer` header works.

"Which sites load angular.min.js?", "Find shops on .de that use the Klarna widget
and show the code around the match", "How many PublicWWW searches do I have left
today?" The query syntax: [publicwww.com/docs/query-syntax](https://publicwww.com/docs/query-syntax/).

- [PublicWWW MCP server](https://github.com/publicwww-com/publicwww-mcp) - Claude,
  ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and others
- [Documentation](https://publicwww.com/docs/mcp/)
